confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Galle's tourist pricing, not live listings or booking pages. Restaurant and meal anchors are more reliable than hotel and hostel anchors, which vary widely by season and location within the city. Alcohol prices are less certain because of Sri Lanka's high alcohol taxes. The FX observation was taken from search-result snippets of rba.gov.au pages, not from a page I opened directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: South Asian coastal tourist towns, using Galle Fort tourist pricing as the reference point. No specific city was used as a direct comparison.
